faces.paragraph: `station ports` lists every TCP port that listens on a Mac or a VM, each in the class of who reaches it. Which ports a VM may open, and to whom, are its [rights](#right): a port that starts listening inside them is shared with their audience within seconds, one outside them is flagged and never shared.

items.markdown: `station ports` lists every TCP port that listens on a Mac or a VM, each in the class of who reaches it. Which ports a VM may open, and to whom, are its [rights](#right): a port that starts listening inside them is shared with their audience within seconds, one outside them is flagged and never shared.
A VM's rights are the `ports` of its Machinefile ([Machinefiles](machinefiles.md)): which ports it may open, and to whom.

props.means: what a machine may open and to whom, its Machinefile's `ports`: `open`, `to` (its audience), `except`, `audiences`
